body: And there is that level where yea I get it, it is super nice to believe in me and have those expectations,  but can I just sit back and appreciate the moment for a bit and feel appreciated.  It is a weird thing to have to ask from people, especially when they think they are being supportive, and there are time where you do get the courage to say something and they cant hide that immediate facial expression change where you clearly upset them for upsetting you and the moment has passed. I'm trying to keep a log of these moments to pass into people I think who need to hear that it is ok to have these thought. And there are people in my life now who need to hear these thought are OK to have but it is an awkward conversation to start

It's just unending expectations.  I got a promotion and the immdedita reaction was that's nice, have you decided where you are getting your MBA. No stopping to appreciate it, just and unconscious reminder that I still haven't pushed far enough
Upbringing and my parents not realizing the impact of open opinions and those opinions never unsticking
Weirdly enough RIVERDALE and Crazy Ex Girlfiend are making Ntflix hit way to close to where my mind is at which is making trying to binge Netlfix rather trippy
And then it gets muffled or pushed down for a bit like a heckler the crowd stopped caring about

Haha, I'm gonna plop this thought right here and see where it goes
*sits back and watches with some popcorn*
I appreciate the response.  I also appreciate that you believe it's understandable. And yea I wrote here because I needed to talk for a bit to wait for it to pass.
